stage: Additional descriptive metric defined after early text results, before calculating any table scores; does not replace preregistered prose CER selection.
reference: IBM PubTabNet TEDS; pinned source/license under research/pubtabnet
normalization: first HTML table; strip thead/tbody/tfoot; th->td; preserve cell characters; clamp similarity to [0,1]; empty invalid prediction=0
gold: all annotation category_type=table with nonempty html; select html field, never best-of html/html_2
matching: normalized bbox IoU >= .5 maximum-cardinality one-to-one; unmatched gold scores 0; extra predictions included in localization precision
primary_table_metric: mean structure-only TEDS per gold table; content TEDS secondary because mathematical cell serialization differs
limits: Project diagnostic, not official OmniDocBench metric; coordinate differences and small sample; no formula semantics claim
